title: Breeze Shaders
description: Lightweight cinematic shader with biome-colored fog, dynamic foliage, atmospheric skies, and immersive weather.
body:
# Breeze Shaders

A lightweight cinematic shader for Minecraft Java Edition.

## Features

- Soft shadows
- Improved water reflections
- Biome-colored fog
- Custom End atmosphere
- Dynamic foliage waving
- Transparent snow particles
- Smooth lighting
- Atmospheric sunrise and sunset
- Underwater effects
- Portal distortion fixes

## Requirements

- Iris Shaders
- Sodium

## Supported Versions

- 1.21.11
- 1.21.1

This project is currently experimental. Feedback and bug reports are welcome.
